implementation.io_basis: Provider and sources are owned by a single file thread. OS I/O never runs under the lease mutex or Tokio executor. Authority/output stop before an already-blocked read may release its original handle. Actual owned completion is reported; cleanup timeout is sticky.
implementation.authorization_basis: Current FileRead permission and exact generation plus independent local per-root consent. Component-wise no-follow capability handles, portable paths, regular/single-link/same-filesystem objects, Unix NONBLOCK and Windows read-only sharing. Cached retries recheck local consent; root revoke can preserve viewing.
implementation.integrity_basis: Full original source digest, exact resume identity/offset, sequential hashed chunks, whole original-handle revalidation, and actual local prefix-plus-new-bytes verification.
known_limitations: Atomic destination storage, uploads, directory browsing, Android SAF, browser/product UI and installed clients remain unimplemented.
Actual private files over pinned direct TLS/direct QUIC loopback do not establish WSS or company/mobile-network product file workflow acceptance.
The reliable byte-stream mode retains wire head-of-line blocking; independent QUIC streams and a separate file worker do not establish a product latency guarantee.
An already-blocked OS read may retain its owned thread/handle beyond 250 ms; authority/output stop first and actual cleanup is separately visible.
Clocksource change and rollback observations are retained; switching alone does not establish a causal explanation for earlier test failures.
Multi-node coordination, TURN/edge/tunnels, aggregate quotas, full clients/IPC/installers/signing/hardware, 72-hour and formal acceptance remain incomplete.
